 with zipfile.ZipFile(archive) as z:

  end=raw.rfind(b'PK\x05\x06');check(end>=0 and end+22==len(raw),'malformed EOCD')

  check(disk==cd_disk==0 and disk_count==count==len(infos) and count<65535 and cdoff+cdsize==end,'invalid/split/ZIP64 central directory')
  names=set();aliases=set();meta=[];intervals=[];cursor=cdoff
  for i in infos:
   name=i.filename;check(name==i.orig_filename,'truncated name')
   check(name and '\\' not in name and ':' not in name and not name.startswith('/') and not any(ord(c)<32 or ord(c)==127 for c in name),'absolute/control/ambiguous name')
   key=name[:-1] if name.endswith('/') else name
   check(all(x not in ('','.','..') and not x.endswith((' ','.')) for x in key.split('/')),'traversal/normalized alias')
   alias=unicodedata.normalize('NFKC',key).casefold();check(key not in names and alias not in aliases,'duplicate/Unicode/case alias');names.add(key);aliases.add(alias)
   mode=i.external_attr>>16;kind=stat.S_IFMT(mode)

   check(stat.S_ISDIR(mode)==i.is_dir(),'type/name disagreement');check(not(mode&0o7000),'special mode')
   check(not(i.flag_bits & ~0x800) and i.compress_type in (0,8) and i.extract_version<=20 and i.volume==0,'unsupported/malformed entry flags')
   check(i.file_size>=0 and i.compress_size>=0,'invalid sizes')

   check(centname.decode('utf-8' if i.flag_bits&0x800 else 'cp437')==name,'central name decoding mismatch')
   # Extra fields must have complete nonduplicate TLV framing; Unicode aliases and ZIP64 are refused.
   for extra in [i.extra]:

     check(pos+4<=len(extra),'malformed extra header');eid,sz=struct.unpack_from('<HH',extra,pos);pos+=4
     check(eid not in seen and pos+sz<=len(extra) and eid not in (1,0x7075,0x6375),'ambiguous/malformed extra');seen.add(eid);pos+=sz
   off=i.header_offset;check(off>=0 and off+30<=cdoff and raw[off:off+4]==b'PK\x03\x04','local entry signature/bounds')

   while pos<len(localextra):
    check(pos+4<=len(localextra),'malformed local extra');eid,sz=struct.unpack_from('<HH',localextra,pos);pos+=4
    check(eid not in seen and pos+sz<=len(localextra) and eid not in (1,0x7075,0x6375),'ambiguous local extra');seen.add(eid);pos+=sz

   member=pin['member'];i=z.getinfo(member);check(not i.is_dir(),'approved member is directory')
   relative='provenance/'+pathlib.PurePosixPath(member).name if 'original.md' in member else pin['planned_export_destination']
   check(member.startswith('SRC-001-closed-development-calibration-reference/evidence/transfer/'),'unapproved prefix')
   event={'sequence':str(len(report['member_selection_events'])+1),'source_archive':containers[0],'exact_member_path':member,'operation':'ZipFile.open exact allowlisted member; bounded stream; CRC checked by zipfile','destination_relative':relative}
   report['member_selection_events'].append(event)

   h=hashlib.sha256();length=0
   with z.open(i,'r') as src, dest.open('xb') as dst:

     length+=len(chunk);check(length<=int(pin['declared_byte_length']),'member exceeds pin');h.update(chunk);dst.write(chunk)
   dest.chmod(0o644);actual='sha256:'+h.hexdigest()
   event['streamed_bytes']=str(length);event['sha256']=actual
